goal: Realistic, modest interior-designer refresh of the user's own bedroom, shown from the same photo view, achievable with new textiles, lighting, decluttering and small decor only.
facts: The room is a teenage bedroom with dark cherry wood furniture, blush walls and parquet floor.
locks: Same room, same camera position, framing and perspective as the reference photo.
Keep the room architecture: walls, window, doors, closet, ceiling height and parquet floor.
Keep the existing dark cherry wood furniture in place and unchanged in shape: sleigh bed, nightstands, dresser with carved mirror.
Keep the blush-pink wall colour and the pink-and-silver glam style.
freedoms: Bedding, pillows, rugs, lamps, small decor, art framing and arrangement, curtains and the ceiling light fixture may change.

direction.thesis: Soft, pulled-together glam: the same room, just edited and styled.
direction.signature: Warm lamp light and one large cream rug tying the cherry furniture together.
direction.avoid: A showroom makeover with new furniture, new paint, or a different room layout.

composition: Same viewpoint and crop as the reference photo.
rendering: Photorealistic smartphone interior photo, natural daylight from the window plus warm lamp light, true-to-life materials.

instructions: Do not add new text; keep existing signs as they are.

references.purpose: preserve room geometry, furniture and camera view

authority.intended_use: Private interior redesign mockup of the user's own bedroom for personal use.

review_tests: Dresser and mirror keep their carved shape and position.
Dresser top shows no folded clothes.
Window is fully visible with longer curtains.
Result looks like a real photo of the same room, not a render of a new room.
